summary: In community.vmware, vmware_dvs_portgroup mac_learning is deprecated in favor of network_policy.mac_learning.
questions: Where should I set MAC learning for a distributed port group?

answer_card.title: vmware_dvs_portgroup mac_learning moved
answer_card.answer_md: In `vmware_dvs_portgroup`, top-level `mac_learning` is deprecated. Set it under `network_policy.mac_learning`.
